name: Curve Finance StableSwap Factory

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The weakest authority shape found on any chain this project tracks: admin is a single bare EOA - not a Safe, not a timelock.
narrative.detail: Curve’s own deployment repo says so explicitly: “deployer as admin until DAO ownership transfer.” Confirmed live (the address has zero contract bytecode) and confirmed actively exercised - on-chain history already shows this key calling Set_new_fee and Ramp_A on a live, ~$2.4M-TVL pool.

steps.what: admin() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (2 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# admin() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.monad.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x8271e06e5887fe5ba05234f5315c19f3ec90e8ad","data":"0xf851a440"},"0x6b54525"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.monad.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (2 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.monad.xyz -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x6b54525"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 112542996 and 112543013 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 2 transactions sent; delay: none
